# QATQ v0.4.4: Zstd maintenance update

QATQ v0.4.4 updates Zstd to 0.14.3 while preserving the existing exact tensor compression interfaces and file formats.

## What changed

- **Compression dependency:** The locked Zstd version moves from 0.14.2 to 0.14.3.
- **Compatibility:** QATQ and QATC formats, public APIs, and research tool contracts remain unchanged.
- **Validation:** Release checks cover exact round trips, public compression gates, and independent certificate reproduction.

This maintenance release introduces no new compression-performance, runtime-integration, or capacity claims. See the [changelog](https://github.com/kabudu/qatq/blob/v0.4.4/CHANGELOG.md) and [release evidence](https://github.com/kabudu/qatq/blob/v0.4.4/docs/PUBLIC_RELEASE_0_4_4_EVIDENCE.md).

## Install

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf https://github.com/kabudu/qatq/releases/download/v0.4.4/qatq-installer.sh | sh
```
